name: 表示順の説明と宿泊条件と特典を備える検索結果面
prompt:
Create a Japanese mobile search-results screen for existing Lighthouse catalog component LH01-0139, 表示順の説明と宿泊条件と特典を備える検索結果面, at the current saved Japanese native preview bounds of 390×1060.

Reference roles:
1. The original target-region crop controls the source screen structure and order, original icon silhouettes and stroke weight, the four filled gold rating stars plus a separate thumbs-up, the protected room photograph, and the visible blue Booking.com/Visa artwork.
2. The existing Japanese native preview supplies the exact Japanese copy and localized yen examples, plus the existing Japanese wrapping/layout where it agrees with the source structure. Do not copy its five green outline stars, missing thumbs-up, substituted utility-icon shapes, alternate photo crop, or missing card artwork.

Preserve the full visible hierarchy: destination/date row; Sort, Filter and Map actions; two category chips; payment-order disclosure with close action; result count; exactly one property card with heart, four gold stars, separate thumbs-up, membership badge, score/review count, location, room details and price comparison; then the complete member-benefit card. The target ends after that benefit card. The next property listing is outside this component crop and must not be added.

Use the current Japanese copy and values exactly:
東京、日本; 3月17日〜19日; 並べ替え; 絞り込み; 地図; ホテル 1,044件; 貸切の宿泊先 1,678件; 施設からの支払いが表示順に影響する場合があります。; 詳しく見る; 2,897件の宿泊先; 東京のレジデンス; 会員特典; 8.3; とても良い; 76件の口コミ; 荒川区・中心部から8.2km; アパートメント・32㎡; ベッド3台・寝室1室・バスルーム1室; 1泊 ¥9,600; 2泊の合計; ¥36,000 crossed out and ¥19,200 total; 会員カードの特典; 旅行をしながら特典を受け取る; 対象のカードでのお支払いによる特典の案内です。; 条件が適用されます.

Keep the established typography: Meiryo, bold 20/28 px, body 14/24 px, metadata 12/16 px, tracking 0. Preserve roles and wrapping; do not shrink text or flatten hierarchy.

Use the collection treatment for localized surfaces: pure white canvas and cards, forest-green action/member treatments, slate utility icons, quiet borders and restrained shadows. Keep gold rating marks and the original blue card artwork as semantic source details; do not tint the whole screen green.

Deliver only the screen at 390×1060 on white, with no phone status bar, source footer, outer device frame, nested container or added margins. Preserve the original room photo and blue card artwork without redrawing them. If ImageGen changes protected media materially, record the candidate as needs-correction rather than treating a lookalike as preserved.
reviewNotes:
